title: Collect Stamps and Enjoy FREE Ayam Set!
description:
Why eat the same thing every day? 👀

Come to PenYet Express and try 2 DIFFERENT Ayam Sets — then enjoy 1 FREE regular Ayam Set on your next visit! 🍗🎁

Choose your favourites:
🔥 Ayam Gepuk
🔥 Ayam Penyet
🔥 Ayam Geprek

Here’s how:
1️⃣ Try your first Ayam Set and collect 1 stamp
2️⃣ Try a different Ayam Set and collect your second stamp
3️⃣ Redeem the remaining regular Ayam Set for FREE on your next visit!

Try 2 different sets. Get the third one FREE. 😋

*Dine-in only. One stamp per receipt. Complete and redeem within 30 days from the first stamp. Lunch Sets are eligible for stamp collection but not for the free redemption. Other T&Cs apply.

📍 Penyet Express at Lot LG-13, LG Floor

#PenYetExpress #TryTwoGetOneFree #CollectYourStamp #promotion #SunwayKluangMall
